en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a large public square and garden with a prominent monument at its center. The statue stands on a tall pedestal in a circular plaza surrounded by trees and paths. In the background are mountains and several towers and historic buildings. Printed red text at the top identifies the location as Piazza Dante with its monument and public garden in Trento.
